fingerprint.bandicam: 8.3.0.2533 GDI Nvidia NVENC (encoder tag of the file)
fingerprint.fps: variable, 30 nominal; 22095 video frames in 1102.77 s

interventions.what: Bandicam window capture of the Isle Wars Pro game window; the owner played one game from the options screen to the end screen (18:23 recording). The video file is the only output. No scripted clicks. Counters, seats and screens were read from pixels by region comparison and template matching of glyph shapes, with no OCR pass.

start_state.restore: Owner launched a new game on the unregistered Pro build from the options screen (seat 1 human, three computer seats, middle strength). Pro has no save file (C-SET-05), so no state was restored. The recording starts on the title screen; the opening deal is the first board.

args: probe: 1102.77 s, 22095 video frames, variable frame rate (nominal 30), 1920x1080 H.264, AAC 48 kHz stereo, 134194220 bytes
ffmpeg 8.0.1; the panel regions were read frame by frame from the container timestamps; offsets are mm:ss.mmm video offsets
record content: the 47 turn starts, army pools, card counts, card draws, the two human trade-ins, the computer trade-ins, both bombs and the elimination of the red seat

observations.field: reading method
observations.value: the scoreboard (top left: four rows with territory count and card count, a marker on the seat whose turn it is) read at every frame where it changed, by matching glyph shapes of its digits (no OCR); a turn starts when the marker moves to the seat; the placement message ("<seat> has N islands. Placing M armies") read for the army pool. Card counts at a turn start are read at the first frame of the marker, so a trade-in made a few seconds into the turn is not yet in them. The same readers as for IP1 027 (E018-r0007).

observations.field: first seat of the game (the draw of the first turn)
observations.value: after the deal the marker flickered over the seats for about 1.5 s (00:19.8 to 00:21.3, 14 moves) and settled on the red seat, which played first (00:21.3); the order then ran red, green, blue, yellow, as the fixed order of the earlier sittings (blue, yellow, red, green) continues cyclically. The first seat was yellow in IP1 026 and the human seat in IP1 027: three games, three different first seats. The red seat made no attack in its first turn (a 3-army pool, no draw).

observations.field: human card draws (card screen at the end of each capturing turn), in order
observations.value: ten draws in the ten human turns with a capture and no earlier trade-in effect: turn 3 the +8 card (card screen at 01:11), turn 15 a second +8 card (03:31), turn 23 the wildcard (05:08), turn 27 the bomb card (07:38; hand empty after the trade-in), turn 31 the doubling card (09:47; hand bomb, double), turn 35 a wildcard (11:38), turn 38 a second wildcard (12:50; hand bomb, double, wild, wild), turn 41 a wildcard after the trade-in (14:42; hand double, wild), turn 44 the +5 card (16:00; hand double, wild, +5), turn 47 the bomb card (18:09; hand double, wild, +5, bomb); the +15 card and the protection card were not drawn by the human; no capture-less human turn drew a card (turns 7, 11, 19 had none)

observations.field: human trade-in 1, turn 27, the trade-in offer from 05:40.3 to 05:49.9
observations.value: the hand held three cards, two +8 cards and a wildcard; the offer was two buttons in the middle panel (trade in, do not trade in) with a text asking to click three matching cards; the owner clicked the three cards one after another (borders at 05:45.0, 05:46.5 and 05:48.0 on the first, second and third), the trade-in button brightened at 05:48.0, and the offer closed at 05:50.0; the placement message then read "1 island, place 16 armies" (the pool before the trade-in was 8 at 05:39.2, 8 plus 8 extra armies made 16); cards 3 to 0 (05:48.9). Set: two +8 cards and a wildcard. The owner did not decline.

observations.field: human trade-in 2, turn 41, the offer from 13:09.2 to 13:38.9
observations.value: the hand held four cards, the bomb card, a doubling card and two wildcards (count 4 at the turn start); the offer was read from 13:09.2; the owner waited about 22 s (the pool message "4 islands, place 21 armies" stayed), then clicked the bomb card (border at 13:31.5) and the two wildcards (13:34.0 and 13:36.5), pressed trade in at 13:38.9, left the doubling card in the hand (hand count 4 to 1), and the middle panel asked to click on a country to bomb (13:39.0); the owner clicked country 8 (yellow, 9 armies) and the panel read the country as the one being bombed (13:42.0); afterwards the pool was still 21 (13:44.0) and the country read 4 armies (13:45.0 to the end of the turn): the country went from 9 armies to 4, which is within 1 to half of 9 (4), a replacement by a draw, not a fixed loss. Set: bomb plus two wildcards (a mixed set with two wildcards). No offer was declined.

observations.field: offers: complete list
observations.value: the trade-in offer appeared in exactly two human turns (27 and 41), both accepted; no offer was declined; hands at the other turn starts held no set (turn 31: bomb and double; turn 35: bomb, double, wild; turn 44: double and wild; turn 47: double, wild, +5)

observations.field: computer trade-ins
observations.value: yellow turn 24: cards 4 to 1 at 05:14.0, message "8 extra armies" (05:14.2), pool message "2 islands, place 19 armies" (05:17.0); yellow turn 36: cards 4 to 1 at 11:44.3, message for bombing a country (11:46.0 to 11:50.0), pool 16 unchanged ("3 islands, placing 16 armies" at 11:43.8); country 43 (blue, 3 armies) read 1 after the bomb (within 1 to half of 3, floored at 1), with the other changes in that window being the placement of the pool (country 3 plus 14, country 9 plus 1, country 13 plus 1)

observations.field: the elimination of the red seat and its cards
observations.value: attack 57 (yellow, country 3 against country 2, strip from 11:52.4) took the red seat's last country; at 11:55.1 red's cards went from 4 to 0 and yellow's stayed 1 (yellow then drew one capture card, 1 to 2 at 11:58.0): the eliminated seat's cards vanish and are not inherited (F012, Q-SUR-03)

observations.field: full hand
observations.value: the green seat held 5 cards from 08:13.0 to the end (turns 30, 34, 37, 40, 43, 46): in turn 34 it captured once with 5 cards and still had 5 at its next start; the yellow seat held 5 cards only briefly (no sixth); no discard prompt was seen
